lines.en: Welcome back, Theo! It must have been hard to get used to the snow after growing up in Perth.
lines.pt: Bem-vindo de volta, Theo! Deve ter sido difícil se acostumar com a neve depois de crescer em Perth.

lines.en: It took a while to get used to the cold. At first I couldn’t get used to wearing three jackets.
lines.pt: Demorou para me acostumar com o frio. No começo eu não conseguia me acostumar a usar três casacos.

lines.en: How long did it take you to get used to the dark afternoons? Winter there starts so early.
lines.pt: Quanto tempo levou para você se acostumar com as tardes escuras? O inverno aí começa tão cedo.

lines.en: About two months. I slowly got used to waking up in the dark, and I even got used to walking on ice.
lines.pt: Cerca de dois meses. Aos poucos me acostumei a acordar no escuro, e até me acostumei a andar no gelo.

lines.en: Impressive! I’m still getting used to the cold mornings in Perth after living in Dubai for years.
lines.pt: Impressionante! Eu ainda estou me acostumando com as manhãs frias de Perth depois de morar anos em Dubai.

lines.en: You will get used to it. Everybody gets used to something new when they have no choice.
lines.pt: Você vai se acostumar. Todo mundo se acostuma com algo novo quando não tem escolha.

lines.en: Maybe. Did you have to get used to the food too? I heard people there eat a lot of fish.
lines.pt: Talvez. Você também teve que se acostumar com a comida? Ouvi dizer que lá comem muito peixe.

lines.en: Yes, and I never got used to the coffee. But I got used to sharing a small flat with strangers.
lines.pt: Sim, e nunca me acostumei com o café. Mas me acostumei a dividir um apartamento pequeno com desconhecidos.

lines.en: That sounds difficult. My cousin couldn’t get used to living abroad, so she came home after six months.
lines.pt: Parece difícil. Minha prima não conseguiu se acostumar a morar fora, então voltou depois de seis meses.

lines.en: Some people never get used to it. It takes patience, and you have to stop comparing everything with home.
lines.pt: Algumas pessoas nunca se acostumam. Exige paciência, e você tem que parar de comparar tudo com sua casa.

lines.en: Wise words. I’ll try to get used to the cold mornings here before next winter, then!
lines.pt: Palavras sábias. Vou tentar me acostumar com as manhãs frias daqui antes do próximo inverno, então!

facts.label: Get used to
facts.sub: Processo de adaptação: It took a while to get used to the cold. Passado: got used to. Presente: I’m getting used to. Depois de to, use -ing.

facts.label: Acostumar-se
facts.sub: Use get used to + -ing para o processo de se acostumar: It took a while to get used to the cold. Forma: get + used to + -ing ou substantivo. Em português: “me acostumar”.

facts.label: Processo ≠ estado
facts.sub: I’m getting used to the cold = ainda estou me acostumando. I’m used to the cold = já estou acostumado. Get used to mostra a mudança; be used to, o estado já atingido.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Get used to means to become accustomed to something.
After get used to, we use the infinitive.
“I got used to the cold” is about a change in the past.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Get used to means to become accustomed to something. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
After get used to, we use the infinitive. → Falso (We use -ing or a noun.)
“I got used to the cold” is about a change in the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Back home after a year in the snow · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a warm afternoon in Perth. Theo has just come home after a year in the snow. He was homesick for months. His friend Owen wants to hear everything. Living abroad was hard, and culture shock was real. They talk about how he learned to adapt.

“Welcome back, Theo! It must have been hard to get used to the snow after growing up in Perth.” says Owen. “It took a while to get used to the cold. At first I couldn’t get used to wearing three jackets.” says Theo. “How long did it take you to get used to the dark afternoons? Winter there starts so early.” says Owen.

paragraphs: “Some people never get used to it. It takes patience, and you have to stop comparing everything with home.” says Theo. “Wise words. I’ll try to get used to the cold mornings here before next winter, then!” says Owen. Theo laughs and orders another coffee. He misses the snow, but not the dark days. Owen asks to see the photos. They sit in the sun and talk. Patience helped him cope with everything. Now Theo is getting used to the heat again.
